set.body:
Outcome: recover the original FilmFestival transcribe.py and its invocation/environment/model provenance, then apply one recorded ASR approach to local dataset stimulus videos. Owner extended scope to Sherlock and other dataset videos for consistency.
Scope: 11 FilmFestival corrected presentation clips and 2 Sherlock presentation parts presently found under data/. Alternate raw/candidate downloads are not presentation inputs. Inventory other datasets explicitly and record absent video rather than infer availability. Keep existing transcripts and source media; new outputs carry exact clip/method/model/runtime identity and all raw flags. No participant recall or gold reads. No automatic library integration or new public types/dependencies in this recovery/application slice.
Acceptance: original scripts recovered byte-for-byte with remote/local hashes; dependencies and pinned model snapshot recorded; a local method instance runs a bounded smoke and validates JSON/TSV/timestamp outputs, failure and stale-output refusal; all selected clips receive complete transcripts or explicit failed outcomes under one settings/model pin, never filename-only reuse. Keep historical ASR outputs unchanged. Preserve multipart native clocks and do not invent scanner offsets. Record actual runtime portability differences from upstream and QC limitations. Review exact retained scripts/receipts independently; keep transcripts in ignored local storage. No efficacy/calibration or downstream scientific result follows from ASR completion.
Next: recover scripts under data/media-tools/asr, pin environment/model, inventory selected inputs, run one short smoke, then bounded serial batch with dashboard/log/exit/output receipts. Record IDs and next decision before yielding. Existing weighted-mapping test edits belong to another task and must be untouched.
set.title: [media] Recover and apply consistent stimulus-video transcription
